_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu na Chluicheadair {player_id}, a' cluich {num_rounds} cuairtean de Geam Ultimatum Iterated.
Tha ${pool} agad airson a roinn eadar thusa fhèin agus Cluicheadair {other_id} an cuairt seo.

Tagraiche:
  - Dean cuideachadh: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ma tha e a' dol a dh'fhàgail → Tha thu a' faighinn $(pool - X), tha an cluicheadair eile a' faighinn $X
  - Ma tha e a' dol a dh'fhàgail → Tha an dà chuid a' faighinn $0
  - Eisimpleir: [Offer: $3]  no  'Tha mi a' smaointinn gu bheil e cothromach. [Offer: $5]'

Freagairtiche:
  - Dean beachd air a' chuideachaidh le [Accept] no [Reject]
  - Eisimpleir: 'Tha e a' dol a dh'fhàgail cothromach. [Accept]'
            'Tha e ro dhòcha. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tha Cuairt {round_number} a' tòiseachadh! ---
Tha Cluicheadair {proposer_id} na thagraiche, tha Cluicheadair {responder_id} na freagairtiche.
round.offer: Cuairt {round_number}: Tha Cluicheadair {proposer_id} a' tabhann ${offer} do Chluicheadair {responder_id} (a' giùlan ${keep}).
round.accepted: Chaidh Cluicheadair {responder_id} a ghabhail! Cuairt {round_number}: Cluicheadair {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Cluicheadair {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Iomraidhean ùra: Cluicheadair 0: ${total_0}, Cluicheadair 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Chaidh an tairgse a dh'fhàgail le Cluicheadair {responder_id}! Cuairt {round_number}: Chaill an dà chluicheadair $0. Tha iomraidhean a' dol a dh'fhàgail: Cluicheadair 0: ${total_0}, Cluicheadair 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Feumaidh an t-solaraiche tairgse a dhèanamh le bhith a' cleachdadh cruth [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Feumaidh suim an tairgse a bhith na fhìor àireamh iomlan.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Feumaidh an tairgse a bhith eadar $0 agus ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Chan eil tairgse gnàthach ri freagairt.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Feumaidh an Freagairtiche [Accept] no [Reject] a' chuideachaidh a ghabhail.

outcome.win: Bhuannaich Cluicheadair {winner} le ${winner_total} iomlan an aghaidh ${loser_total} aig Cluicheadair {loser}.
outcome.draw: Dealbhaich! Chrìochnaich an dà chluicheadair le ${total} gu h-iomlan.
